caption: Santa Maria della Salute, Venice
composition: Baroque dome of La Salute on the Grand Canal · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Seen from the Grand Canal, the great white dome of La Salute dominates the right of the frame, its scrolls and twin smaller domes catching the 09:51 morning light, with the palazzi of the canal stretching away to the left. Gondolas lie moored along the far bank at the lower left, and the water is calm and green-grey. The church's pale stone glows against a soft blue sky.
